title: Subword Tokenization — BPE, WordPiece, Unigram, SentencePiece

questions.question: Subword tokenization (子词分词) 相比词级别词表能带来什么好处？
options: Rare words decompose into known subword pieces, eliminating OOV while keeping vocabulary bounded (罕见词分解为已知的子词片段，在消除 OOV 的同时保持词表有界)
Smaller models (更小的模型)
Faster training (更快的训练)
Better embeddings (更好的嵌入)
questions.explanation: Subword tokens cover any input by decomposition, removing the OOV problem of word-level vocab.

questions.question: 为什么 GPT-2 使用 byte-level BPE (字节级 BPE) 而非 character-level BPE？
options: Required by transformers (transformer 所要求的)
Byte BPE skips merges (字节 BPE 跳过合并)
A 256-byte base vocabulary covers any UTF-8 input, guaranteeing no [UNK] tokens (256 字节的基础词表覆盖任意 UTF-8 输入，保证没有 [UNK] token)
Bytes are smaller (字节更小)
questions.explanation: Byte-level BPE starts from 256 bytes so every input encodes; nothing is OOV.

questions.question: Unigram tokenizer (Unigram 分词器) 如何构建词表？
options: Greedy IDF weighting (贪心 IDF 加权)
Start from a large candidate set, iteratively prune tokens whose removal least hurts corpus log-likelihood (从大的候选集开始，迭代剪除移除后对语料 log-likelihood (对数似然) 影响最小的 token)
Greedy frequent-pair merging (贪心高频字符对合并)
Random sampling (随机采样)
questions.explanation: Unigram fits a unigram LM and iteratively removes the least useful tokens to reach target vocab size.

questions.question: WordPiece 的合并准则与 BPE 有何不同？
options: WordPiece uses bytes (WordPiece 使用字节)
WordPiece is unsupervised (WordPiece 是无监督的)
WordPiece merges pairs that maximize training-corpus likelihood, while BPE merges the most frequent pair (WordPiece 合并最大化训练语料 likelihood (似然) 的字符对，而 BPE 合并最频繁的字符对)
WordPiece skips merges (WordPiece 跳过合并)
questions.explanation: WordPiece picks merges by likelihood; BPE picks by raw frequency.

questions.question: 哪个工具直接在原始多语言 Unicode 文本上训练分词器？
options: spaCy
tiktoken
tokenizers-lite
SentencePiece (encodes whitespace as a special marker and trains BPE or Unigram) (将空白编码为特殊标记并训练 BPE 或 Unigram)
questions.explanation: SentencePiece trains BPE/Unigram on raw text without pre-tokenization; tiktoken only encodes.

questions.question: 为什么生产环境的 CI 必须对部署的 tokenizer.json 进行哈希检查？
options: Tokenizer drift (分词器漂移) produces different token IDs from those the model was trained on, silently corrupting outputs (产生与模型训练时不同的 token ID，静默地破坏输出)
Required by Hugging Face (Hugging Face 要求的)
To compress storage (压缩存储)
It reduces vocabulary size (减小词表大小)
questions.explanation: Even small tokenizer changes shift IDs; a hash check catches drift before it reaches users.

questions.question: 单个 emoji 占用多个 token 的常见原因是什么？
options: Emojis are reserved (表情符号是保留的)
Multi-codepoint emojis encode into multiple UTF-8 bytes; without dedicated tokens each byte is its own subword (多码点表情符号编码为多个 UTF-8 字节；没有专用 token 时每个字节都是一个子词)
Emojis are stored as floats (表情符号以浮点数存储)
Emojis are stop characters (表情符号是停止字符)
questions.explanation: Composite emojis encode as several bytes; byte-level tokenizers may use multiple tokens per glyph.

questions.question: 新的单语 transformer 的词表大小应遵循什么启发式规则？
options: Always 8000 (总是 8000)
Always 1M (总是 1M)
Roughly 32k for models under 1B parameters; 50-100k for 1-10B; 200k+ for multilingual or frontier models (<1B 参数约 32k；1-10B 约 50-100k；多语言或前沿模型 200k+)
Match training corpus size (匹配训练语料大小)
questions.explanation: Vocab size scales with model and language coverage; these are rough community defaults.
